profileSettings.connectedAccountsDescription: Your profile email may differ from your social account email. Both can be used to access your account.

accountSecurity.title: Account Security
accountSecurity.description: Add a verification step when you sign in. It’s optional and off by default.
accountSecurity.enabled: Two-factor authentication is on. Manage your methods or turn it off.
accountSecurity.emailUnavailable: Email verification is unavailable. Check that your primary email is verified and forwarding is enabled.
accountSecurity.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
accountSecurity.qrLabel: Scan to connect your authenticator app
accountSecurity.saveCodes: Save these codes somewhere safe. Each works once if you can’t use your email or authenticator app.
accountSecurity.removeConfirm: You can still verify with your other available methods.
accountSecurity.disableConfirm: You won’t need a second code to sign in. Your authenticator app and backup codes will be removed.
accountSecurity.regenerateConfirm: Your current backup codes will stop working.
accountSecurity.chooseIntro: Choose how you want to receive a sign-in code.

choose.totp: Get a code from an app like Google Authenticator or 1Password.
choose.email_code: Receive a code at your verified primary email.

accountSecurity.backupLater: You’ll get backup codes after verifying your method.
accountSecurity.emailSetup: Send a code to {{email}} to turn on two-factor authentication.
accountSecurity.manageIntro: Your default method is offered first when you sign in or confirm a change.
accountSecurity.emailDestinationHelp: Choose where we send codes. You’ll verify the new address first. Your account email doesn’t change.
accountSecurity.backupOnly: Use if your usual method is unavailable.
accountSecurity.loadFailed: We couldn’t load your security settings. Please try again.

accountConfirmation.disconnectMessage: You will no longer be able to sign in with this {{provider}} account. Make sure you have another way to sign in.
accountConfirmation.title: Confirm your identity
accountConfirmation.password: Enter your current password to protect this change. You won’t be asked again for 20 minutes.
accountConfirmation.email_code: Send a code to your verified primary email to confirm it’s you.
accountConfirmation.emailDestination: Send a code to {{email}} to confirm it’s you.
accountConfirmation.sent: Code sent. It expires in 10 minutes.
accountConfirmation.codeSentTo: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {{email}}.
accountConfirmation.codeSent: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to your email.
accountConfirmation.failed: We could not confirm your identity. Please try again.
accountConfirmation.totp: Enter the current code from your authenticator app.
accountConfirmation.recovery_codes: Enter an unused backup code. Each code works once.
accountConfirmation.noMethod: No verification method is available. Contact support for help recovering access.

auth.oauthError: Unable to sign in. Please try again.
auth.existingAccountHelp: Sign in with a method you already use for Starview, then connect the new account from your profile.
auth.linkExplanation: Accounts stay separate until you verify ownership. After linking, either sign-in method opens the same profile on any device.
auth.finishLink: You’re signed in. Connect the new sign-in method below to use it with this profile.

location.nearbyError: We couldn’t load nearby sites. Please try again.
location.unavailable: Couldn’t get your current location. Search for a city or check your browser’s location permission.
